verdict.rationale: Veriff automatically creates separate test integrations for development. Sessions in them don't count toward paid usage, and you can trigger decisions for test sessions, so verification flows can be exercised without live verifications. A Postman collection is also available for trying the API. missing for 10: an explicit statement that test-integration data is isolated from production data, documentation of test fixtures or simulated documents, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox workflow.
